title: Hydrated Light Chinese Apple Tagine
description: A fermented and springy Chinese dish from Zhejiang featuring apples, made in a ceramic tagine and dehydrated for a low-sodium friendly meal.

ingredients.name: Apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other firm variety

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine the fermented bean paste, ginger, and garlic, and blend until smooth.
In a large ceramic tagine, combine the blended paste, apples, green onions, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Add the water to the tagine and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine with a lid and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Once cooled, place the tagine in the refrigerator to chill for at least 2 hours.
Before serving, dehydrate the apple mixture in a low-temperature oven or dehydrator for 1 hour.
Serve the hydrated light Chinese apple tagine chilled or at room temperature.
